tools.name: bitly_get_user
tools.description: Return the Bitly user that owns the access token (login, name, default group). Bitly API: GET /v4/user.

tools.name: bitly_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Bitly organizations this user belongs to. Bitly API: GET /v4/organizations.

tools.name: bitly_get_plan_limits
tools.description: Return the monthly plan limits and usage for an organization (API calls, short links, custom back-halves, redirects). Bitly API: GET /v4/organizations/{organization_guid}/plan_limits.

tools.name: bitly_list_groups
tools.description: List the Bitly groups (workspaces) the user can see, optionally in one organization. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups.

tools.name: bitly_get_group
tools.description: Return one Bitly group with its settings and organization. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups/{group_guid}.

tools.name: bitly_list_group_bitlinks
tools.description: List the bitlinks (short links) in a group, newest first, with filters. Page with search_after from the last result. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups/{group_guid}/bitlinks.

tools.name: bitly_get_group_clicks
tools.description: Return click counts for every link in a group, bucketed by unit. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups/{group_guid}/clicks.

tools.name: bitly_get_bitlink
tools.description: Return one bitlink: its long URL, title, tags, archive state and creation time. Bitly API: GET /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}.

tools.name: bitly_get_bitlink_clicks
tools.description: Return click counts for one bitlink, bucketed by unit. Bitly API: GET /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}/clicks.

tools.name: bitly_get_bitlink_clicks_summary
tools.description: Return the total clicks for one bitlink over a window. Bitly API: GET /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}/clicks/summary.

tools.name: bitly_get_qr_code
tools.description: Return one Bitly QR code: its destination, design and short link. Bitly API: GET /v4/qr-codes/{qrcode_id}.

tools.name: bitly_get_qr_code_scans_summary
tools.description: Return the total scans for one QR code over a window. Bitly API: GET /v4/qr-codes/{qrcode_id}/scans/summary.

tools.name: bitly_shorten_link
tools.description: Shorten a long URL into a bitlink. Without force_new_link, Bitly returns the existing bitlink for the same URL. With force_new_link=true, each call creates another bitlink, so do not retry it. Bitly API: POST /v4/shorten.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bitly_get_bitlink · Private data: bitly_get_user · Public sink: bitly_shorten_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bitly_get_bitlink · Private data: bitly_get_user · Public sink: bitly_shorten_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
